title: Chapter 785
paragraphs: Chapter 785
Episode 193. Shamaness(3)
Valeria looked at Sanna, hiding her perplexed heart. Judging from the influence on the record magic and her reading of Yona's movements, it was clear that she was a character with divine power.
"I'm Jin Runcandel."
"Yes, and you must be the Nameless King, Yona, and Valeria."
"You seem to know us well."
"I can't help it."
"You introduced yourself as the shamaness of the Sun, does that mean you serve Kinzelo?"
"That's right."
"I'm referring to the sun god Kinzelo, not the terrorist group Kinzelo."
"I understood in that context and gave you the answer. Seeing as you know the name, it seems you've heard from Orgal."
Jin did not answer and looked around for a moment. The monsters in the form of Kelliark were still prostrating towards Sanna, but their number had decreased from before.
Some had completely disappeared when Sanna's prayer ended. It was a different scene from the monsters they killed on the way, who resurrected by converging into spirits again.
'It doesn't seem like Bale, who uses the same power of the sun god, could perfectly eliminate the monsters like this.'
Then, Sanna must be handling a higher level of power than Bale. Her combat power could also be higher, even if it wasn't revealed.
"I assume you have many questions. About these thought forms in the shape of Kelliark Zipfel, and about me."
"Do you plan to tell if I ask?"
"If you don't act threateningly, I will tell as much as you want."
"Then, I want to hear about this situation first. What is the cause of the Story Tower being like this?"

"A monster. Kelliark Zipfel, the head of the Zipfel family, wanted to get the power like a monster. With the help of Hwarong Kadun. That's why Veradin and the family's mages had no choice but to suppress them."
Sanna was nonchalantly talking about the massive betrayal within Zipfel.
"...Kelliark Zipfel, who couldn't even move in the maintenance device?"

"As you know well, the power of chaos drives people into madness. Not least Kelliark Zipfel, who had Creation before his eyes, he was even more vulnerable to being possessed by the devil. To put it simply, Kelliark fell for the temptation of chaos, like the old master of Runcandel."
"Not only the possession, but the role of a prophet was significant in making the monster. If Kelliark wanted to become a monster, it seems there was similar interference."
Saying so, Jin stared at Sanna as if to ask if she was the one who played the role of the prophet.
"You suspect me."
"Why wouldn't I suspect an unidentified character who suddenly appeared? To my eyes, you seem quite similar to the prophet who was in Runcandel."

"I understand. But I am a shamaness serving the sun god Kinzelo, of course, what I want is only the advent of him in this world again. If a new monster destroys the world, I cannot fulfill my mission. This is also why the Beast King Orgal, he combined forces with the passage to prevent the monster."
Without Yuria, I cannot fully trust a single word Sanna says. However, even if Yuria were here, for some reason it seemed that the power of Aze Mill would not work on Sanna. Same as Orgal.

"Sanna, as far as I know, the resurrection of the sun god is not included in the goal of Zipfel. Why are you with Zipfel, not your religious peers? They are obsessed with the resurrection of the sun god."
"Let's just say our sects are different. Besides, from what I saw from afar, they seemed to have some issues with intelligence. A bit difficult to work together..."
"Different sects. This means there could be other followers of the sun god besides you and Orgal's Kinzelo."
"Of course."

"Also, your Kinzelo and Orgal's Kinzelo might each have different methods to resurrect the sun god. So I especially find it hard to believe what you just said. The sect you belong to might intend to resurrect the sun god only after destroying the world entirely. Using entities like a monster."
Sanna stared at Jin for a while without answering. Then she took off her hood and revealed her bare face, her golden hair and pupils shining more intensely than Bale's.
"It seems that your sect has instilled a very bad impression of the Sun God religion. Although our sects are different, I'll apologize on their behalf. We are not crazy like that."
"You should cooperate closely between sects and pay attention to the image of religion. But, is Lokia Ganesto also included in the sect you belong to?"
"That's a name I'm hearing for the first time."
"If there is, tell her. I don't know why she betrayed the family, but soon she'll pay the price. If she needs to explain, tell her to come find me."
In a one-sided conversation, Sanna did not openly show any displeasure.
Sanna seemed to have no intention of revealing any more information about herself. Jin refocused on Kelliark's thought forms.
"You've been worrying since earlier about how the idea entities seem to be worshiping you."
"Oh, that's because I've purified the insides of the idea entities through prayer."
"Purification?"
"The idea entity is a byproduct derived from Kelliark's survival instinct and resentment. Just by existing, they are subjected to terrible pain they can never alleviate on their own."
"So you've removed that pain through prayer?"

"Yes. It's the same principle as when wounded beasts offer their hearts when you heal them. Once the pain is purified, the idea entities naturally dissipate and disappear. It's because there's no basis for them to exist as figures, like their survival instinct and resentment."
"Pacify the spirits and get rid of them. Hmm, sounds like something a cult would say. Do you charge for it? It seems effective, so it's okay to charge for it."
"Because it's not a cult."
"Where is Kelliark Zipfel?"
Upon hearing that, Sanna lowered her head with a dark expression.
"Actually, that's why I allowed Jin to come. We are certain he's alive but we don't know how he escaped from the battlefield or where he's hiding."
Sanna explained the situation during the battle for a while.
According to her, Kelliark was not in a situation where he could survive the battlefield 'without someone's help'.

"......Fortunately, at the time Lord Veradin began to suppress him, Kelliark was in the most unstable state just before becoming a fiend. So we could suppress him without the help of other forces. But at the moment we tried to cut him off, he unleashed the legacy of the Demon Emperor, and disappeared after the backlash."
"Weren't there any troops surrounding him?"

"There were. While the battle was prolonged, all the mages nearby were besieging this area. But no one confirmed the moment Kelliark escaped. He literally disappeared into thin air, along with the fire dragon Kadun."
"So it was spatial movement."

"We're assuming so, but Kelliark couldn't control his soul energy properly. In the first place, spatial movement through soul energy is possible only for a complete, or at least near complete fiend. It's not an option that Kelliark, who was suppressed before gaining full control of his power, could choose."
"So you want me to check it with Hister's recording magic?"
"That's correct."
At Jin's signal, Valeria stepped forward.
The record window she opened detailed the combat situation while the conversation continued.
However, it was a record manipulated by Sanna. Valeria continued to pretend to analyze the record without telling Jin about it.
"Lokia Ganesto rescued Kelliark Zipfel on the brink of annihilation and escaped the Tower of Narratives."
'It's not over here, Kelliark Zipfel. You need to stand up to Chiron once you're complete.'
The name Lokia came up again, just like when we looked into Luntia's sub-space. The party could not take their eyes off the record window, their pupils dilated.
'Oppose my father……?'
-'If Chiron Runcandel returns as he is, your brother won't be able to handle him. Absolutely not without my help.'
The record found in Luntia's sub-space.
Even in the record we just found, Lokia was conscious of Chiron. As if she could not complete her plan as long as Chiron existed.
"......Lokia Ganesto? I didn't expect to see the name that Jin mentioned here. Who on earth is she?"
While the party took some time to choose their words.
Valeria noticed that unlike the time in Luntia's sub-space, the sentences that popped up on the record window were 'clearly maintained.'
"Lokia Ganesto is a former knight of Runcandel. Also, she is a person that Zipfel has erased from history."
"That means she may have held a grudge against Zipfel and saved Kelliark."
"Well, it's more strange that you've been saying you don't know her since earlier."
"You're free to doubt me. But as far as I'm concerned, I can only think that Lord Veradin's judgment was correct. We found the clues so quickly. We should report to Lord Veradin immediately."
"Will Zipfel start looking for Lokia Ganesto from now on?"
"He should. Thanks to Jin. However, you wouldn't expect any rewards, would you? I made sure Jin could inspect the Tower of Narratives himself."
Jin nodded his head, watching Sanna about to get up.
"Good, it seems we both have gained something. Let's part ways here."
There would be no more information to gain from Sanna.
"It was nice to meet you, Lord Jin. Please take a good look around."
Syris summoned Mort.
Sanna watched the white dimensional door that Mort had entered for a while.
"Indeed......you're quite sharp, Lord Jin Runcandel. I almost got flustered."
And while running through the extra-dimensional tundra, Valeria said to her colleagues with conviction.
"The record that Lokia Ganesto saved Kelliark, it's manipulated. That person named Sanna deliberately changed the record."
